The '''AHH Striker tactical vest''' was a model of load-bearing gear available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It cost 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], allowing its user to carry additional equipment.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
